ethic.definition:
n. the principles of right and wrong that are accepted by an individual or a social group
n. a system of principles governing morality and acceptable conduct
ethic.translation: n. 道德规范, 伦理

ethical.definition:
a. of or relating to the philosophical study of ethics
a. conforming to accepted standards of social or professional behavior
s. adhering to ethical and moral principles
ethical.translation:
a. 伦理的, 民族的, 民族特有的
[医] 伦理的, 道德的

ethical drug.translation: [医]合乎规格的药物，凭处方出售的药物

ethical society.translation: [网络] 伦理社会；伦理协会

ethically.definition: r. in an ethical manner; from an ethical point of view; according to ethics

ethician.definition: n. a philosopher who specializes in ethics

ethicism.translation: [网络] 伦理主义；道德主义

ethicist.definition: n. a philosopher who specializes in ethics

ethicists.definition: n. a philosopher who specializes in ethics

ethicize.translation: vt. 使伦理化, 认为...合乎道德, 使有道德

ethics.definition: n. the philosophical study of moral values and rules
ethics.translation:
n. 道德规范
[医] 伦理学

ethide.definition:
n. Any compound of ethyl of a binary type; as, potassium
   ethide.

ethidium.translation: [化]溴乙非啶,溴化二氨乙苯啡啶

ethinamate.translation:
[化] 炔己蚁胺
[医] 烃己蚁胺, 瓦尔米

ethinyl estradiol.translation:
[化] 炔雌醇; 乙炔雌二醇
[医] 乙炔基雌二醇

ethinylestradiol.translation: 乙炔雌二醇; 炔雌醇

ethionamide.translation: n. [药]乙硫异烟胺(一种抗结核药)

ethiop.translation:
n. (=Ethiopian)阿比西尼亚人
a. (=Ethiopian)阿比西尼亚的

ethiopia.definition: n. Ethiopia is a republic in northeastern Africa on the Red Sea; formerly called Abyssinia

ethiopian.definition:
n. a native or inhabitant of Ethiopia
a. of or relating to or characteristic of Ethiopia or its people or languages
ethiopian.translation:
a. 埃塞俄比亚的
n. 埃塞俄比亚人

ethiopian monetary unit.translation: [网络] 埃塞俄比亚货币单位

ethiopians.definition: n. a native or inhabitant of Ethiopia
ethiopians.translation: n. 埃塞俄比亚人, 黑人( Ethiopian的复数形式 )

ethiopic.definition:
a. Of or relating to Ethiopia or the Ethiopians.
n. The language of ancient Ethiopia; the language of the
   ancient Abyssinian empire (in Ethiopia), now used only in the
   Abyssinian church. It is of Semitic origin, and is also called Geez.
ethiopic.translation:
a. 埃塞俄比亚的
n. 埃塞俄比亚语

ethiops.definition:
n. A black substance; -- formerly applied to various
   preparations of a black or very dark color.

ethisterone.translation: n. [生化]脱水羟基孕酮,孕烯炔醇酮, 乙炔基睾丸酮
